name: Accursed Forge-Spurned
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

items.name: Soul Chain
items.description: An accursed forge-spurned's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Soul Chain] is a +2 greater striking flaming adamantine @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Spiked Chain].

items.name: Warhammer
items.description: This weapon has a wooden shaft ending in a large, heavy metal head. The head of the hammer might be single-sided or double-sided, but it's always capable of delivering powerful bludgeoning blows.

items.name: Full Plate
items.description: Plate mail consists of interlocking plates that encase nearly the entire body in a carapace of steel. It is costly and heavy, and the wearer often requires help to don it correctly, but it provides some of the best defense armor can supply. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Padded Armor] and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Gauntlet]{gauntlets}.

defensiveAbilities.name: Eternal Damnation
defensiveAbilities.description: As long as its soul chain remains intact, the accursed forge-spurned can't be truly destroyed and rises again fully healed at the next sundown, even if its physical body was destroyed.

defensiveAbilities.name: Searing Heat
defensiveAbilities.description: A creature that touches the accursed forge-spurned (including Grappling it or hitting it with an unarmed attack) takes 4d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 33 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Forge Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The accursed forge-spurned breathes a cloud of stinging soot, ash, and glowing embers. This can affect either a 30ft Cone or a 20ft Burst centered on the accursed forge-spurned and persists for 1d4 rounds.

Creatures that move into or start their turn in the area take 12d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 36 Reflex Saving Throw save).

A creature that fails its save is also Blinded for 1 minute. Creatures within the cloud are Concealed, though not from the accursed forge-spurned.

The accursed forge-spurned can't use Forge Breath again until it has used Inflate Bellows.

offensiveAbilities.name: Inflate Bellows
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The accursed forge-spurned has used Forge Breath.

Effect The accursed forge-spurned re-inflates its flaccid lungs, enabling it to use Forge Breath again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Soul Chain
offensiveAbilities.description:
If a creature is slain by an attack from the soul chain and the accursed forge-spurned is able to retain the creature's corpse, it can bind the creature's soul into the soul chain (as Seize Soul) with a day of work at a forge and a DC 20 Crafting check.

An individual whose soul is bound in this way can't be resurrected unless the soul chain is destroyed (Hardness 10, 40 HP, BT 20).

offensiveAbilities.name: Soul Siphon
offensiveAbilities.description:
When the accursed forge-spurned critically hits a target with its soul chain, the chain leeches away a portion of the target's soul. The target must attempt a DC 36 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Drained 1.

Failure The target is Drained 2.

Critical Failure The target is drained 2 and Stunned 2 from the pain.
